language.name: English
login.tagline: Chat with your Oracle Analytics data and get a workbook ready to import.
login.hint: Queries run with your OAC identity and permissions.
card.chartTypeTooltip: To do: change the chart type
card.insightNote: peak, minimum, change — highlighted on the chart
workbook.empty: Add the visuals you need from the conversation: they will land here and then in the workbook.
workbook.specTooltip: The neutral JSON the analysis produces: a platform adapter (OAC today) turns it into the workbook.
sidebar.hint: Changing the dataset starts a new session.
sidebar.historyNote: Past analyses, grouped by day. Needs an endpoint that lists the sessions.
chat.pickDataset: Choose a dataset on the left to start.
chat.empty: Ask something about {name}: for example “how are sales doing by quarter?”
chat.failed: Model error: {error}. The question was cancelled, you can try again.
ask.placeholder: Ask a question about the data…
ask.hint: Enter to send · Shift+Enter for a new line
settings.title: Settings
settings.firstRun: To start you need the Oracle Analytics address and an LLM provider key.
settings.oacUrlHint: The instance address is enough. If you change it, you need to sign in again.
settings.modelHint: Applies to the chats you start from now on.
settings.apiKeySaved: saved: leave empty to keep it
settings.apiKeyHint: Stays in the backend ({path}): the browser never sees it again.
settings.compartmentHint: The one in the API key policies: the Generative AI API requires it in every request.
chat.notice.empty: (the model did not write an answer: try the question again)
chat.notice.tooManySteps: (stopped: too many steps for one question)
preview.radar: In OAC it is a radar. Here as bars: lengths compare better than angles.
preview.boxplot: In OAC it is a box plot of the distribution. Here the totals by category.
preview.narrative: In OAC the descriptive text is generated by OAC from these values.
preview.mapNoCoordinates: In OAC it is a map of {count} places, but none has known coordinates. Here the first {shown} by value.
preview.mapShown: {count} places out of {total}, approximate positions; circle area = {measure}.
preview.mapSkipped_one: {count} with a null or negative value not shown.
preview.mapSkipped_other: {count} with a null or negative value not shown.
errors.oacUrlMissing: The Oracle Analytics URL is missing: open Settings.
errors.oacSessionExpired: The OAC session expired: sign in again.
errors.oacPage: Oracle Analytics answered with an error (HTTP {status}): {text}
errors.sessionNotFound: This session no longer exists (the backend restarted?): choose the dataset again.
errors.datasetNotVisible: This dataset is not visible to you.
errors.questionRunning: A question is already running in this session.
errors.testFolderMissing: Folder “{folder}” not found in the catalog.
errors.testFolderAmbiguous: {count} folders “{folder}” in the catalog: cannot choose where to write.
errors.oacDidNotSave: OAC did not save the workbook (status {status}).
errors.orderMismatch: The order must contain exactly the pinned visuals.
errors.noPinnedVisuals: No visual in the workbook yet.
errors.dvaSkeletonMissing: No skeleton .dva is configured, so the .dva download is off: export an empty workbook from OAC and set SKELETON_DVA (see the README). Save to OAC works without it.
settings.errors.oacUrl: The OAC URL must start with https:// (e.g. https://<instance>.analytics.ocp.oraclecloud.com).
settings.errors.compartmentFormat: The compartment OCID starts with ocid1.compartment. (or ocid1.tenancy. for the root).
probe.usesToolsNumbersAsText: the model uses tools (but passes numbers as text)
probe.noTool: it answered without using the tool: “{text}”
probe.empty_one: empty answer, no tool call ({tokens} token generated)
probe.empty_other: empty answer, no tool call ({tokens} tokens generated)
settings.errors.baseUrl: The server URL of the OpenAI-compatible provider is missing.
settings.errors.baseUrlFormat: The server URL must start with http:// or https:// (e.g. http://localhost:11434/v1).
settings.errors.noModel: No model chosen yet: pick a provider and a model in Settings.
settings.baseUrlHint: Any server with the OpenAI Chat Completions API and tool calling: Ollama (http://localhost:11434/v1), vLLM, LM Studio… The model must support tools: use “Verify the model”.
settings.apiKeyOptional: optional: leave empty if your server needs none
settings.modelPlaceholderCustom: model name on your server, e.g. qwen2.5:14b
